title: PHase IV Clinical Trial of Ceftriaxone Sodium and Sulbactam Sodium for Injection (CRO-SBT)
brief_summary: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of treatment of children with acute bacterial infection disease with Ceftriaxone Sodium and Sulbactam Sodium for Injection in the condition of widely used, and provide the basis of adjusting the dosage regimen for children in particular.
